comment: The knobs are named Fade In Speed and Fade Out Speed in the maker's tooltips and marked Speed on the panel, but the value is a duration: the fade position advances by sampleTime divided by the knob, so the fade lasts the knob's value in seconds (src/htFader16.cpp:176, :181). The README says "If only one input is connected only the corresponding output will be active"; the code does the opposite, giving the unpatched side's output a 0V to 10V fade envelope (:282, :287), which is what the same README says two paragraphs earlier. The lines follow the code. Nothing is written to an output pair while both of its jacks are unpatched (:278).
